overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Reserve Edition 4-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna with Himalayan Salt Bar offers a premium wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this spacious sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a sanctuary for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features 9 advanced heaters, including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels, ensuring a safe and effective infrared experience. Enhance your relaxation with the built-in chromotherapy lighting and enjoy seamless connectivity through the touch screen control panel with Bluetooth and MP3 capabilities.
